Fixed with a max-width:640px media query allowing .sg-ref to wrap and drop its auto left-margin. Re-verified: 0 elements exceed viewport bounds outside intentional overflow-x:auto demo containers (the nav-demo component preview, which is deliberately shown at native width in a scrollable box).
Consistent with the .sg-* framework reference look across Colors/Type/Motion/Buttons/Forms/Components/Patterns/Tokens: card padding, radii, label pills, and dt/dd spec grids all consistent.
Swatches confirmed against canon: paper #F3F5FA, ink #141D35, accent #B94612/#EA5E14 all present with matching rendered swatch backgrounds.
All 8 TOC links (#colors #type #motion #buttons #forms #components #patterns #tokens) resolve to a matching id in the DOM; verified live in-browser.

Zero console errors/warnings from the page itself on desktop or mobile load. (Unrelated cross-tab noise from other concurrently-open browser tabs in the shared browse daemon, e.g. gstatic.com boq-labs-tailwind/boq-bard-web preload warnings, was observed and excluded; the page never references those domains.)
Fraunces/Inter/JetBrains Mono loaded via Google Fonts preconnect + stylesheet link, with sane fallback stacks (Georgia serif, system-ui sans, ui-monospace mono).
Zero unicode em-dashes (—) and zero — HTML entities anywhere in the file (grepped, both forms).
Only border-left usage is .sg-note, a documentation callout/blockquote pattern (not a content card), acceptable and distinct from the banned 'colored strip down a card edge' AI-slop pattern.

Global blanket rule @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}} covers every animation/transition in the file, including the always-looping demo-*, beat, pop and feedCross keyframes.

Automated WCAG contrast sweep + visual screenshot inspection found 3 real defects in the dark Motion section, all now fixed: (1) '.step-demo' (Contact stepper transition demo) was missing the standard .sg-stage light-paper wrapper used by every other demo, so its dark-navy '--ink'/'--muted'/'--blue' text rendered nearly invisibly on the dark card background (~1.0-2.3:1) -- fixed by wrapping it in .sg-stage like its siblings. (2) '.count-demo' (Count-up stats) had the identical missing-wrapper bug, same fix applied. (3) The 'Easing & reduced motion' demo box had its paragraph text set to rgba(255,255,255,.62) (a dark-section text color) while sitting on the light .sg-stage background, rendering as pale-on-pale; fixed to var(--muted)/var(--blue) set directly on the

/ tags (an ancestor-div color didn't take effect because a more specific '.sg-section.dark p' rule overrode inherited color). Re-swept after fixes: 0 elements below the 4.5:1 (normal text) / 3.0:1 (large text) threshold.

fixed: Added @media(max-width:640px){.sg-ref{white-space:normal;margin-left:0}} so long component-reference badges wrap instead of overflowing off-screen on mobile.

Wrapped .step-demo (Contact stepper transition, Motion section) in .sg-stage to restore the light-paper backdrop its text colors were designed for -- was rendering as near-invisible dark-on-dark text.
Wrapped .count-demo (Count-up stats, Motion section) in .sg-stage for the same reason -- '16 SHIPPED' etc. were nearly unreadable.

Fixed the Easing & reduced motion demo's paragraph/label colors (moved from a non-effective wrapper-div style to var(--muted)/var(--blue) set directly on the

/ elements) -- was rendering pale white-ish text on a light background, nearly invisible.
